title: A Network-Based Examination of the Longitudinal Association Between Psychopathy and Offending Versatility
limitations: - Reliance on self-report measures; - Limited number of waves (7) may reduce power to detect true edges; - Mono-operation bias; - Potential confounding by maturation or treatment effects.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. However, the authors mention that analyses were conducted using a tuning parameter to avoid Type I error, which suggests methodological rigor. The code and data are declared available, but supplementary materials are restricted to authorized users.
